purpose: Determine whether a distinct Gram/cross-moment noise correction warrants new conditional development; not precision confirmation
selection: First six Q1 blocks, exactly the subset used in completed V2, without outcome selection
known_structure_scope: Saved Q1 family and active destinations/partition supplied; this is conditional method development
noise_model: Independent additive Gaussian error per node and field; supplied forcing treated as exact; sigma estimated as 0.0005 times each observed training-field RMS
nonzero_acquisition_clipping: Retain as failed preflight; local Gaussian moment calculation is not applicable without a clipping model
mean_correction: Subtract the nodewise second-order Taylor mean shift in nonlinear reaction columns
new_correction: Subtract linearized column-error Gram and column/target cross moments in the quadratic normal equations
distinction: Not the old low-order quadrature correction, mean-only diagnostic, fixed covariance weighting, parameter-dependent Gaussian likelihood, component search, test enrichment, or state reconstruction

screen_gate.meaning: Prospective practical screen for further study, not an accuracy/adoption or statistical significance gate

stopping: Stop after these 18 points. If screen fails, do not launch corrected-risk fits or noise/weight/threshold scans. A passed screen requires a separately frozen development protocol before any nonlinear fit.
negative_corrected_risk: Allowed as an unbiased-risk estimate; no logarithm, positive floor, or relabeling as likelihood
indefinite_corrected_gram: Record failure; no eigenvalue clipping or regularization tuned to pass
